title: Equal separated planets in one moving ring
question: Drive B CW. Determine the motion of C (spin) and H (orbit) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive B CW. Internal mesh A/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. A held, B positive. Internal mesh C/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. C held, B positive. The parallel linkage holds the orientation of A while its center travels on the arm. A held. 12 × (A − H) − 48 × (B − H) = 0. 12 × (C − H) − 48 × (B − H) = 0. The requested motion is stationary / CW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: C must be stationary. Internal mesh C/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. C held, B positive..

options.label: B
options.explanation: C must be stationary. Internal mesh C/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. C held, B positive.. H must be CW. Internal mesh A/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. A held, B positive. Internal mesh C/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. C held, B positive..

options.label: C
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: D
options.explanation: H must be CW. Internal mesh A/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. A held, B positive. Internal mesh C/B (12/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. C held, B positive..
